headline.purpose: Page/month title and dialog titles only.

body.purpose: Default for nearly all interface text.

label.purpose: Uppercase section headers (Presets/Sources/Types) and weekday abbreviations.

shadows.name: chrome-rest
shadows.purpose: Near-invisible shadow-xs on resting buttons/inputs; not a real elevation cue.

shadows.name: floating-dialog
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, popovers, toasts — content lifted above the calendar canvas.

motion.name: overlay-fade-zoom
motion.purpose: Dialog/popover entrance — reinforces the floating-above-canvas metaphor.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(234 89% 60%); color: #fff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(234 89% 54%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid hsl(234 89% 60%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Hairline-border button used for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fafafa; color: #1a1c23; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eceefe; }

components.name: Event Chip (block)
components.description: Signature component: full-width colored event row. Color is per-event-type user data, not a system token — indigo used here only as a placeholder.
components.css: .ds-event-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; background: hsl(234 89% 60%); color: #fff; border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.1s; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-event-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-event-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-event-chip-title { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Tinted Icon Badge
components.description: Small inline event-type indicator used in sidebar rows: color-tinted background, full-strength icon color.
components.css: .ds-icon-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(234 89% 60% / 0.125); color: hsl(234 89% 60%); font-size: 0.625rem; }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: Hover-highlighted list row (source/type entry) with hover-revealed actions.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-sidebar-row:hover { background: #f1f2f4; } .ds-sidebar-row-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(234 89% 60%); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-sidebar-row-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #1a1c23; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text field, hairline border, accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #1a1c23; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(234 89% 60%); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a8190; }

components.name: Whisper Label
components.description: Uppercase section header used above Presets/Sources/Types lists.
components.css: .ds-label { font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; color: #7a8190; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

narrative.overview:
Dense, simple, and legible — with legibility earned through customization rather than in spite of it. The interface itself carries almost no fixed opinion about color: the user's own choices (accent hue, font, corner radius, and, above all, the rules that assign a display type to each event) are what make the calendar legible to them specifically. The shell stays warm and approachable — soft corners, calm neutrals, no sharp edges or technical chrome — so the customization surface reads as a personal instrument, not a generic SaaS settings page.

Almost every piece of interface text runs at 12px or smaller; hierarchy comes from weight, case, and color, not from large type jumps. This is deliberate: the app's job is to stay out of the way of a dense grid of events, so its own chrome whispers.
keyCharacteristics: Warm and approachable, not clinical — rounded corners, calm neutrals, one accent used sparingly.
Dense-but-legible: small type (mostly 12px), tight row padding, weight/case carry hierarchy instead of size.
Near-flat: shadows are reserved for things that float above the calendar (dialogs, popovers, toasts), never for resting chrome.
Personalization is structural, not decorative: accent color, font, and corner radius are all runtime-resolved theme variables, never hardcoded.

rules.name: The Accent Is Yours Rule
rules.body: The primary/accent color is a user-chosen theme variable resolved at runtime (resolveThemeCssVars, src/lib/theme.ts), never a hardcoded hex in a component. Indigo is only the default new users see.

rules.name: The Event Color Is Data Rule
rules.body: Per-event-type colors are user content, not system tokens, and are deliberately excluded from this file's palette. The system's own chrome never competes with them for attention.

rules.name: The Whisper Label Rule
rules.body: Section labels run at 10px uppercase with wide tracking specifically so they read as structural scaffolding, not content — never scale a label up to compete with real event data.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: If it's part of the calendar's resting layout, it stays flat. If it's floating above the calendar (dialog, popover, toast, dropdown), it may cast a shadow. Nothing in between.

rules.name: The Tinted Icon Rule
rules.body: Small inline status/type indicators use a color + 20% alpha background tint rather than a solid fill; solid fill is reserved for the larger, single-focus event chip itself.

dos: Do resolve every color, font, and radius through the theme CSS variables (resolveThemeCssVars) — never hardcode a hex, a font-family string, or a rounded-* pixel value in a new component.
Do default new interface text to text-xs (12px); reserve text-sm/headline for page and dialog titles only.
Do use the color + 20%-alpha tint pattern for small inline icon badges, and reserve solid color fills for the primary event chip.

Do keep settings/customization panels (theme editor, rules, display types) feeling like the product's main instrument, not a generic buried settings page — this is the actual differentiator, treat it with the same craft as the calendar grid.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to anything sitting flat on the calendar canvas (rows, buttons, the grid itself) — shadows are reserved for content floating above it (dialogs, popovers, toasts).
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a fixed "brand color" anywhere — the accent is a per-user variable, and a hardcoded second hue would fight it.
Don't let the customization UI drift toward generic-SaaS visual sameness (heavy card grids of toggles, gradient headers) — keep it warm, compact, and specific to this app's density-first character.
